changeRecord.title: load sign flipped
changeRecord.target: load 1 of case D (memberDistributed on B1)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Loads are signed along the positive axes: gravity on a model with Z up is a negative Z value. A load with the wrong sign acts upwards or to the other side; in combination with the other loads it relieves where it should add, so the governing forces, the governing combination and even the sign of the reactions (uplift) change.
changeRecord.precondition: a nodal load, member load or imposed support displacement

reference.note: the reference solution is the analysis (and design) of the perturbed model, once verified

verification.route: benchfea verify: every applicable tier; tier C (two independent solvers) is expected to be able to follow the perturbed model

verification.meaning: 'verified' means only: the reference solution passed every tier listed as applicable in this record, at the tolerances stated in it. It does not mean reviewed, approved or certified by anyone.
